speedinvest._readme: Durable identity corrections consumed by build-company-base.py on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md s8): one company rendered under different names across Speedinvest's surfaces (the live Webflow CMS 2025-26, its 2023-2025 per-company pages captured by Common Crawl, the 2017-2020 WordPress listings and pages, the Getro board) and its renames. Written at the first build 2026-09-30 (PRO-84).

merges.name: Ona
merges.reason: one company: Gitpod (the firm's own /portfolio/gitpod page, 2024-2025 captures) renamed itself Ona in 2025; the live site lists Ona at /portfolio/ona

merges.name: Elephant Healthcare
merges.reason: one company: the firm's page /portfolio/elephant-healthcare (2025 capture) titled 'Elephant'; the board lists Elephant Healthcare

merges.name: CrateDB
merges.reason: one company: Crate.io (the firm's listings since 2017, invested 2014) renamed its company and product CrateDB; the board lists CrateDB at cratedb.com

merges.name: Breathe Battery Technologies
merges.reason: one company: the board's 'Breathe' (breathebatteries.com) is the site's Breathe Battery Technologies (London, Imperial College spin-out)

merges.name: YardLink
merges.reason: one company: the 2020 capture spells YardLink 'Yardlynk'; the live site lists YardLink (yardlink.com)

merges.name: FairMoney
merges.reason: one company: Predictus (the firm's 2018-2019 listing) renamed itself FairMoney; predictus.io redirects to fairmoney.io (research g02, 2026-09-30)

merges.name: Second Nature
merges.reason: one company: OurPath (the firm's 2018-2019 listing) renamed itself Second Nature; the live site lists Second Nature (research g02, 2026-09-30)

merges.name: Ivary
merges.reason: one company: Juno Fertility (the firm's 2017 team-card listing, Vienna) renamed itself ivary in 2017; juno-fertility.com redirects to ivary.io in the Sept 2017 capture (research g00)

merges.name: wefox
merges.reason: one company: FinanceFox (the firm's 2017 listing, founded 2015 by Julian Teicke) rebranded as wefox; the firm's own 2017 wefox card cites FinanceFox's rounds (research g03)

merges.name: Rive
merges.reason: one company: Kodit.io (Helsinki iBuyer, the firm's 2018-2019 listing) renamed itself Rive in 2022; the live card sits at /portfolio/kodit-io (research g04)

merges.name: Wegfinder
merges.reason: one company: iMobility GmbH (the firm's 2017 listing) runs the wegfinder app and registered the wegfinder wordmark in July 2017 (North Data); the 2018-2019 listing names Wegfinder (research g07)

merges.name: Flank
merges.reason: one company: Legal OS (the firm's 2019-2024 listing, Berlin) renamed itself Flank; legalos.io redirects (research g10)

merges.name: Necture
merges.reason: one company: Necture GmbH (Vienna) was registered in 2015 as Parkbob GmbH (the firm's 2017-2019 listing), renamed Ubiq GmbH in October 2022 and Necture GmbH in March 2024; the live card reads 'Necture (formerly Ubiq)' at /portfolio/ubiq (North Data; research g04, g11)

merges.name: Fernride
merges.reason: one company: PYLOT GmbH (Munich, the firm's 'pylot-2' page of October 2020) was renamed FERNRIDE GmbH on 2020-11-10 (North Data HRB 252515); the firm's page became /portfolio/fernride by December 2020 (research g04)

merges.name: Flexkeeping
merges.reason: one company: Facility (facility.si, the firm's 2017-2018 listing, partner Werner Zahnt) became facilityforhotels.com and then Flexkeeping, which the live site lists (research g00)

merges.name: Credi2
merges.reason: one company: cashpresso (the firm's 2017-2019 listing, partner Stefan Klestil) is the consumer-credit brand of Credi2 GmbH, Vienna, which the live site lists (research g00)

merges.name: Colorful
merges.reason: one company: zerolens GmbH, Vienna (FN 510990g, registered April 2019 as pixelstore GmbH), sold its product as Zerolens (the firm's 2020-2021 listing), Colorful (the live card, colorful.app imprint) and Mokker AI (the board's row); research g01, g06, g09, recall2

merges.name: Rainbow
merges.reason: one company: RIVERSE SAS (Paris, founded December 2021) renamed its standard and platform Rainbow; riverse.io redirects, and both the live card (Rainbow) and the board (Riverse) point at riverse.io (research g07, g08)
